description.zh:
系统消息扩散类型，取值：

- 0：不扩散。

- 1：扩散到指定人。

- 2：扩散到群组。
description.en:
System message diffusion type. Valid values:

- 0: No diffusion.

- 1: Diffusion to specified users.

- 2: Diffusion to the group.

description.zh:

description.en:
User ID of the operator.

> This parameter is required. The user must be the creator of the group.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limits

The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 100 times/second. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. You should make API calls at a reasonable rate. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~343507~~).
